environment_kit.geometry: Godot primitive meshes generated at runtime
environment_kit.materials: StandardMaterial3D PBR-capable parameters; no external texture files
environment_kit.signage: Generic fictional Arabic/French labels; no third-party trademarks
environment_kit.lod_strategy: detail levels 0-2 using medium_detail_nodes/high_detail_nodes visibility groups

review_constraints: No claim that procedural facades reproduce individual real buildings.
Real OSM geometry/provenance is handled by habib_bourguiba_reference.json.
Future external textures/models must be added to external_visual_assets with license and source before use.
